summary: Comprehensive testing of Device-bound Activation Licensing System. All 20 backend pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend E2E flow verified: Activation gate → invalid code rejection → super-admin API generates code → device activates → EMR login page reached. Super Admin portal (/license-admin/login → /license-admin) accessible without device activation, stats/table/generate/audit UI all functional.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr>'. Appears to originate from an Emergent instrumentation wrapper (x-excluded='true', data-ve-dynamic) that wraps the mapped <tr> elements. Non-blocking dev-mode warning but should be reported to Emergent tooling / not user-fixable.

Backend: POST /api/license/admin/login with invalid password returns 401
Backend: Admin endpoints require Bearer token (401/403 without)
Backend: GET /api/license/public-key returns 32-byte Ed25519 key
Backend: GET /api/license/admin/stats returns total/active/pending/revoked/expired and by_type breakdown
Backend: POST /api/license/admin/generate creates Lifetime license with DDH-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX activation_code and offline_key
Backend: POST /api/license/activate with correct device+code activates (status 'activated', check.is_valid=true)
Backend: POST /api/license/activate with wrong code returns 400 'Invalid activation code for this device.'
Backend: Device binding — code generated for device A does NOT work for device B (400)
Backend: Generate license for types: yearly (365-day expiry), trial (custom trial_days expiry), hospital (no expiry)

Frontend: Activation page displays Device ID in DDH-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format (data-testid='device-id-display')
Frontend: Entering invalid code shows red error 'Invalid activation code for this device.'
Frontend: After entering valid code, page transitions to EMR login (Welcome Back, doctor@clinic.com placeholder) and shows toast 'Device activated successfully!'
Frontend: /license-admin/login accessible without device activation (bypasses activation gate)
Frontend: Super Admin login (superadmin@ddhapps.com / DDH_SuperAdmin_2026!) redirects to /license-admin dashboard
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows stats-grid, license-table, Generate License button, Audit Log button
Frontend: Generate License form opens, accepts device_id + customer_name, and displays generated activation code + offline key on success
Frontend: Audit Log panel opens and displays past operations
action_items: (Low priority / dev-only) Hydration warnings about <span> under <tbody>/<tr>: caused by Emergent's instrumentation wrapper (data-ve-dynamic span) — no user-code fix required, but if it must be silenced, replace the .map() over rows to avoid the wrapper being injected inside <tbody>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3116 lines — should be split into modular routers (licensing, patients, visits, etc.).

Activation code is derived deterministically via HMAC(device_id|app|type). Two consecutive lifetime licenses for the same device+type will produce identical activation codes; acceptable because generate endpoint blocks duplicate active licenses per device, but worth noting.
License extend endpoint re-generates activation_code even for already-activated licenses; the newly generated code is what future re-activation would need — acceptable but should be documented in UI.
Ed25519 keys and MASTER_SECRET correctly loaded from env (backend/.env). Good.
All license admin endpoints properly gated with get_super_admin JWT dependency.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in queries.
seed_data_creation: Test licenses were created during tests and cleaned up (TEST_/PW_ prefixed licenses removed via DELETE endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: License system fully validated end-to-end. Key testids: device-id-display, activation-code-input, activate-btn, offline-key-input, admin-email-input, admin-password-input, admin-login-btn, stats-grid, license-table, generate-license-btn, gen-device-id, gen-customer-name, gen-license-type, gen-submit-btn, generated-result, view-audit-btn, audit-log, transfer-modal, extend-modal. To test in a new browser session: (1) read device_id from data-testid='device-id-display'; (2) call /api/license/admin/login then /api/license/admin/generate via fetch() in-page; (3) fill activation-code-input and click activate-btn. /license-admin/* bypasses the license gate.
